game_concept: A puzzle set in The Kingdom – Harvest Fields, farm fields beyond the walls: the royal scribe must handle mischievous imps while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Swap Switch: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute coins without losing either value.
theme: The Kingdom – Harvest Fields: farm fields beyond the walls
core_gameplay_loop: In Harvest Fields, repeat each round: Swap two variables with a temporary slot to reroute coins without losing either value. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the a value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the drawbridge using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the drawbridge is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 7 (applied tier): Swap Switch
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Swap Switch' (Week 1 slot 4), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Harvest Fields'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

code_snippet:
temp = a
a = b
b = temp
tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how a changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against mischievous imps in Harvest Fields.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The drawbridge reached with actions_used <= 17.
